title: Hand Cream I Keep in Every Bag
hook: I own four of these hand creams. Here's why.
scene1: Creator dumps a tote, a backpack and a gym bag onto a bed; a small tube falls out of each
scene2: Peels the seal on a brand-new tube, close-up of the pastel cap
scene3: Quick swipe on the back of the hand, macro of it soaking in
scene4: Four tubes lined up on a windowsill, morning light, 9:16
voiceover: Okay, slightly embarrassing, but I keep one of these in every bag I own. It's small, it smells clean, and it doesn't leave my phone screen greasy after. This is the new one I just opened for my car.
cta: Would you do this too? Tell me below.

title: Strangers Guess the Price: Travel Blender
hook: How much would you pay for a blender this small?
scene1: Sunny park path, creator holds a palm-sized blender and a mic
scene2: A jogger stops, shakes the bottle, laughs at how light it is
scene3: Three people hold up fingers to guess the price, fast cuts
scene4: Creator reveals the price on a card, park bokeh behind
voiceover: I asked people in the park to guess the price of this tiny blender. Guesses were all over the place, from ten dollars to sixty. Most people were surprised it charges by USB. I'll let you guess before I tell you.
cta: Drop your guess in the comments.

title: Desk Lamp That Changed My Night Shift
hook: Night shift nurses, this one's for you.
scene1: Dim kitchen at 6am, creator in scrubs returning home, drops keys
scene2: Clicks on a warm desk lamp, adjusts the brightness dial slowly
scene3: Reads a book in bed with the lamp angled away from a sleeping partner
scene4: Lamp on nightstand, soft amber glow, phone-camera look
voiceover: Coming home after a night shift means everyone else is asleep. This lamp has a really low warm setting, so I can read and wind down without waking anyone. It's the small things that make this schedule easier.
cta: Save this if you work nights.

title: Messy Closet Before & After: Hanging Organizer
hook: Day 1 vs day 7 with one cheap closet fix.
scene1: BEFORE label: overflowing closet, sweaters falling off a shelf
scene2: Creator hooks a fabric hanging organizer onto the rail, under a minute
scene3: AFTER label: same angle, sweaters folded into neat cubbies
scene4: Split screen before/after, creator's hand gives a small wave
voiceover: This was my closet last week. I'm not a super organized person, so I wanted something I didn't have to build. It just hooks on the rail. Same closet, same clothes, a lot less chaos. Your results depend on how much stuff you have, obviously.
cta: Follow for more small home fixes.

title: Dog Slow Feeder First Try
hook: My dog used to finish dinner in 9 seconds.
scene1: Phone timer on screen, golden retriever inhaling food from a steel bowl
scene2: Creator sets down a puzzle-style slow feeder bowl
scene3: Dog nudging kibble out of the ridges, tail wagging, low angle
scene4: Timer now shows several minutes, dog lying down calmly after
voiceover: My dog used to eat so fast I was honestly worried. A friend suggested a slow feeder, so we tried it tonight. It took him way longer, and he seemed to actually enjoy figuring it out. Check with your vet about what's right for your dog.
cta: Show me your pet's dinner speed below.

title: Resistance Bands Unboxing for Tiny Apartments
hook: Home gym for people with zero floor space.
scene1: Small studio apartment, creator steps over a couch to reach a package
scene2: Unrolls five colored bands with a door anchor on a yoga mat
scene3: Quick demo: bands anchored to the door, two rows and a squat
scene4: Bands rolled up into a pouch that fits in one hand
voiceover: My apartment is so small that a dumbbell rack wasn't happening. So I got this band set. Five resistance levels, a door anchor, and the whole thing fits in this pouch. I did a quick fifteen-minute session right after unboxing.
cta: Follow if you work out at home.

title: Office Workers Rate a Neck Pillow
hook: Can a neck pillow survive the office lunch break test?
scene1: Outside a glass office building at lunch, creator holds a memory-foam neck pillow
scene2: A man in a blazer tries it on a bench, closes his eyes for a second
scene3: Two coworkers pass it back and forth, laughing, giving scores 1–10
scene4: Score cards montage, creator holds pillow up to camera
voiceover: I stopped people on their lunch break and asked them to rate this neck pillow from one to ten. Lowest score was a six, highest was a nine. Most people said it was softer than they expected. One guy refused to give it back.
cta: Would you nap with this? Comment your score.

title: 保温杯日常分享｜通勤族的一天
hook: 一个保温杯，陪我从早上7点到晚上7点。
scene1: 早上7点厨房，倒入热水的保温杯，蒸汽升起
scene2: 地铁车厢里，手握保温杯，窗外光影掠过
scene3: 下午办公桌，拧开杯盖还在冒热气，特写
scene4: 晚上回家，杯子放在玄关柜上，暖色灯光
voiceover: 早上七点装的热水，到下午三点打开还是温热的，这对我这种在公司不想跑去接水的人挺友好的。杯子不大，塞包侧袋刚好。就是普通通勤日，记录一下。
cta: 你通勤会带水杯吗？评论区聊聊。

title: 无线耳机前后对比｜跑步再也不掉
hook: 以前跑步耳机掉了三次，这次一次都没有。
scene1: 标注“之前”：跑步时普通耳机从耳朵滑落，慢动作
scene2: 标注“之后”：戴上挂耳式无线耳机，侧脸特写
scene3: 河边跑道跑步，耳机稳稳戴着，跟拍镜头
scene4: 跑完停下喘气，摘下耳机对镜头点头
voiceover: 之前跑步最烦的就是耳机老掉，一公里要按好几次。换了这副挂耳的，今天跑了五公里一次都没掉。每个人耳朵形状不一样，我只说我自己的感受。
cta: 喜欢跑步的朋友可以收藏一下。
